test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

This antique vase __is good__ piece of work.
solution: The correct answer is **'is a fine'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate answer for the underlined part is** 'is a fine'.** • The adjectives '**good**' and '**fine**' are used in a different contexts. • "**Fine**" generally applies to conditions of health, social or financial conditions, or arts. • "**Good**" generally applies to conditions of moral behavior. • *Example: By the way, the Meat Lover's Skillet **is a fine piece** of work.* **Correct Sentence:__** *This antique vase** is a fine **piece of work.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • रेखांकित भाग के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त उत्तर** 'is a fine' **है। • विशेषण '**good**' और '**fine**' अलग-अलग संदर्भों में उपयोग किए जाते हैं। • "**Fine**" आम तौर पर स्वास्थ्य, सामाजिक या वित्तीय स्थितियों, या कला की स्थितियों पर लागू होता है। • "**Good**" आमतौर पर नैतिक व्यवहार की स्थितियों पर लागू होता है। • *Example: By the way, the Meat Lover's Skillet is **a fine piece** of work.* 37:Teaf, The correct answer is **'What did they teach you at the creative writing workshop?'**
